fusions.name: Sip and Start
fusions.desc: Flicks water at the first enemy it meets: it deals 4 damage, you heal for 20% of the damage dealt, and you move 10% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Brookside Bolt
fusions.desc: A spray from a leap that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks each back 2 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lifted Head
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drinks Between Alarms
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
